user_reported_bug: I am not able to direct login with 9849002111 as super admin. I am not getting access with 9849002111 and the access request is not visible to admins. On prod just says waiting for approval.
summary: No relevant testing skill found. Focused verification shows the normal-state API and UI direct login with 9849002111 now works, and startup backfill restores admin mobile after restart. However, the runtime break-glass layer fails under the requested drift scenario because /api/auth/phone matches an active escort with the same last-10 phone before running super-admin break-glass, returning an escort token and leaving admin@attendance.app downgraded/missing mobile until restored by the test cleanup.

critical.issue: Runtime break-glass does not take precedence over escort matching. After unsetting admin@attendance.app mobile/mobile_last10 and downgrading role to member without restart, phone login for 9849002111 returned HTTP 200 approved for escort 'agape test' (role null, is_escort true) instead of admin, and the original admin row remained role=member with no mobile in the assertion snapshot. This can still deny super-admin access when DB drift exists and an escort shares the whitelisted phone.

action_items: Move/adjust the super-admin break-glass logic so whitelisted SUPER_ADMIN_PHONES are resolved before escort matching, or explicitly ignore escort matches for whitelisted super-admin phones.

Retest drift-corrupted admin row with active escorts sharing +919849002111 to ensure the response user.role is admin and admin@attendance.app is restored to role=admin/mobile=9849002111 without backend restart.
critical_code_review_comments: In /app/backend/routes/auth.py, lines 268-291 return an escort token before the new super-admin break-glass block at lines 293-335. Because _match_escort_by_phone uses mobile_last10, active escorts with +919849002111 preempt the whitelisted super-admin rescue path whenever the admin user is not matched by mobile.
seed_data_creation: No permanent seed data created. Test temporarily unset/restored admin@attendance.app mobile/mobile_last10 and role, created QA device rows, then deleted those QA device rows and restored admin to role=admin/mobile=9849002111.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend API checks: 5/6 passed. Direct 9849002111 API login returned approved admin token; admin email login returned admin token; startup backfill after restart restored mobile/mobile_last10; regular member and unknown phone regressions passed. Failing case: no-restart drift corruption of admin row returned escort identity because two active escorts in DB have mobile_last10=9849002111. UI normal-state login at preview /login passed: entered 9849002111, navigated to /, no pending panel, sidebar showed Admin and Campus Administrator.
rca_of_the_issue: The break-glass block was inserted after the escort-match early return. If admin@attendance.app cannot be matched by phone (the exact production drift class), _match_escort_by_phone can match +919849002111 and return immediately, so the SUPER_ADMIN_PHONES guarantee is bypassed. Backend logs also show startup backfill works on restart, but Layer 2 does not rescue at request time in this DB shape.
